note: Curated HISTORICAL DAMAGE record for the dashboard's Past-events view — SEPARATE from vaishnodevi_documented_landslides.geojson (the validated back-test inventory), which is deliberately untouched. Verification rule (CLAUDE.md / ledger §36-§38): every event is checked against a primary source (GSI / peer-reviewed / SMVDSB records) or 2+ independent press outlets; publication date != event date; LOW-confidence rows are flagged review_needed for the user and rendered as pending review. EXCLUSION RECORD (immunization, never delete): the '2 Sep 2025 new-track rockfall, 3 dead' claim from a deep-research synthesis was verified FABRICATED (no press/GSI trace; the yatra was closed 26 Aug–14 Sep 2025) and stays excluded (§38). Ranking = deaths desc, then injured, then damage_score (0-10 editorial tie-breaker for non-fatal events). Coordinates are approximate anchors (track localities), NOT field-mapped scarps.

events.name: Ardhkuwari landslide disaster (Inderprastha Bhojnalaya)
events.coord_confidence: anchored to GSI slope Nos. 110/111 (the slopes around the incident were pre-flagged by GSI)
events.damage: Debris slide onto sheltering pilgrims near Ardhkuwari during record rainfall (629.4 mm/24 h at Katra, nearly 2x the previous record); worst disaster in the shrine route's recorded history; yatra suspended 26 Aug–14 Sep 2025. GSI preliminary note (29 Aug) recorded 32 dead; the toll rose to 34 in final press reporting
events.confidence_reason: GSI primary source (preliminary note, 29 Aug 2025) + extensive independent press; toll difference (32 GSI-prelim vs 34 final) is explained by the note's 3-days-after timing and is recorded, not hidden

sources.label: GSI, 'A preliminary note on the landslide disaster of 26.08.2025 at Ardhkuwari' (29.08.2025), pp.1-3

events.name: Banganga (Gulshan Ka Langar) landslide, old track
events.coord_confidence: anchored to Banganga locality on the old track (settlement-level, not GPS-precise)
events.damage: Landslide/boulder fall onto the old track — booking office and overhead iron structure caved in; 1 pilgrim killed, 9 injured
events.trigger: Heavy rain — Katra recorded 184.2 mm in the 24 h ending 08:30 IST 21 Jul 2025
events.confidence_reason: Press-verified 2026-07-11 across 3+ independent outlets (Kashmir Reader, The Kashmir Horizon, Greater Jammu, Deccan Herald) — date, casualties and the 184.2 mm/24 h figure consistent

sources.label: Kashmir Reader / The Kashmir Horizon / Greater Jammu / Deccan Herald, 21-22 Jul 2025 (cross-verified set)

events.name: Bhawan rockfall at track km 11.550 (wedge failure)
events.coord_confidence: anchored to the Bhawan complex (event at track km 11.550, foot-slope near the Shrine and Bhairon track)
events.damage: Rockfall by wedge failure in dolomitic limestone/cherty dolomite from the escarpment >400 m above the heavily-inhabited foot-slope; 1 killed, 6 injured
events.trigger: Wedge failure along a bedding shear zone (source escarpment inaccessible)
events.confidence_reason: PENDING USER REVIEW on the date only — GSI Spl.Pub.107 §5.4.4 is a primary source but is internally inconsistent: the section BODY says 30 Aug 2008, 11:00 hrs (adopted, more specific); the HEADING says 30 Dec 2008. Resolve via Kumar (2009a). The event itself (casualties, mechanism, location) is not in doubt

sources.label: GSI Spl.Pub.107 §5.4.4, p.127 (page image read 2026-07-11), citing Kumar (2009a)

events.name: Bhawan complex slope failure (track between elevator point and gate 5)
events.damage: Rain-triggered landsliding damaged the track; the aged Durga Bhawan building had to be dismantled; slope subsequently stabilized with 37 pre-stressed cable anchors (26.5–30.5 m)
events.trigger: Heavy and continuous rain (per the primary source)
events.confidence_reason: Primary-verified 2026-07-11: Naithani AK (2023), Aspects Min Miner Sci AMMS.000775 p.6 (PDF in Research/Vaishno_Devi_Watchlist/), corroborated by SMVDSB/THDCIL stabilization records (ledger §34/§39)

sources.label: Naithani AK (2023), 'Assessment of the Various Slope Stabilization Initiatives...', AMMS.000775 p.6

events.name: Himkoti landslide on the new track (battery-car service suspended)
events.coord_confidence: anchored to the Himkoti locality on the new (battery-car) track — press gives no precise chainage
events.damage: Rain-triggered landslide dumped debris on the new track near Himkoti; battery-car service suspended while the Shrine Board cleared it; the yatra itself continued via the old route; no casualties reported
events.trigger: Intense rainfall (per press); this project's gate held WATCH that day (E=1.06 — armed, below the act-now line)
events.confidence_reason: Verified 2026-07-18: Times of India (user-supplied) + 5 independent outlets (Greater Kashmir, Daily Excelsior, Kashmir Life, Free Press Journal, The CSR Journal) consistent on location (Himkoti, new track), Wednesday-evening timing (8 Jul 2026 was a Wednesday), rainfall trigger and the battery-car suspension

sources.label: Times of India (landslide hits Vaishno Devi track at Himkoti, battery car service suspended)
Greater Kashmir (yatra unaffected, battery car suspended)

events.name: Himkoti track RD 0/850 rockfall with pilgrim casualties (date unknown, pre-Jul 2017)
events.date_note: UNDATED in the source — 'instability in recent past which lead to casualty to pilgrims', pre-30.06.2017 (the SMVDSB request-letter date)
events.coord_confidence: GSI-report DMS coordinates (33°01'47.5"N 74°56'08"E, stated in the report)
events.damage: Casualty-causing instability at the RD 0/850 unstable slope (wedge/topple in highly jointed cherty dolomite, ~67° slope, 30–50 m damage corridor, boulders 0.5–2 m); casualty count not stated in the source
events.trigger: Rain-seepage lubrication mechanism (per the GSI report)
events.confidence_reason: PENDING USER REVIEW — the GSI FS 2017-18 report is primary and credible, but the event is undated and the casualty count unstated, so per the date-verification rule it is recorded as pending, never as a settled dated event (the back-test inventory holds it as a vulnerable location, not an event)

sources.label: GSI open-file report FS 2017-18, 'Landslide and Slope Stability Assessment of Shri Mata Vaishno Devi Himkoti Track' (Singh, Rana & Jungral), Item M4-LS/NC/NR/SU-JK/2017/12224
